retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy radial composition featuring a central isometric emblem overlaid with horizontal scanlines against a deep space warp-speed background.
excludeWhen: organic or hand-drawn styles are requested
static or calm compositions are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A central circular emblem containing an isometric stylized letter, characterized by a heavy horizontal scanline texture, set against a dark purple background with white and pink radial motion streaks emanating from the center.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial streaks converge behind a central circular anchor
Horizontal scanlines unify the central emblem and bottom text
High contrast between white display type and dark purple void
Isometric perspective of the central icon creates depth
coreInvariants: Horizontal scanline texture across all red elements
Radial motion blur emanating from a central vanishing point
Deep purple to black gradient background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large circular emblem dominates the center, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central isometric 'F' symbol within the red ring.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central emblem, follow the radial streaks outward, then move to the top display text and bottom secondary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark purple void between radial streaks provides breathing room for the central subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright White (Top Typography and Light Streaks)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red (Central Emblem and Bottom Text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red with dark value background; high value white for highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses wide, open counters and diagonal cuts
Bottom text is blocky, monospaced, and heavily textured with scanlines
Uniform stroke weight for the top display type
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' and 'A' characters feature open paths or disconnected strokes
The 'E' uses three parallel horizontal bars without a vertical spine
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of clean, airy futuristic curves at the top with dense, textured block forms at the bottom.

avoid: Solid fills for the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the wide, technical base for the top display text.
Matches the square, industrial feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark purple and black background with white and magenta radial light streaks exploding from the center. Place a large red circular ring in the center containing an isometric stylized letter 'F'. Apply a horizontal scanline effect to the red elements.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the top display text in a wide, futuristic white sans-serif. Add the bottom text in a blocky red font with the same horizontal scanline texture as the central logo.

verificationChecks: Ensure radial streaks converge at the exact center of the emblem.
Check that scanlines are perfectly horizontal and consistent across all red elements.
Verify the top text is pure white and the bottom text is red.
Confirm the isometric angle of the central icon matches the perspective of the ring.

adjustableVariables: Isometric angle of the central icon
Tracking width of the top text
postGenerationChecks: Is the scanline effect visible on the bottom text?
Do the radial lines create a sense of forward motion?
Is the top text legible against the light streaks?
Is the central emblem clearly isometric?
recipe.reuseFormula: Radial Motion Background + Isometric Central Emblem + Scanline Texture Overlay + Futuristic Wide-Set Typography
